quarterly_data.signal: Evaxion added EVX-05, an off-the-shelf glioblastoma vaccine targeting ERV-derived antigens shared between patients, developed with Duke University School of Medicine; it is optimizing a lead vaccine candidate, and initial clinical testing is expected to be carried out by Professor Mustafa Khasraw's team at Duke, a collaboration that potentially allows a cost-efficient way to study EVX-05 in a clinical phase 1 trial. The EVX-03 program was discontinued and removed from the pipeline; EVX-05 costs sit within existing budgets and the cash runway into the second half of 2027 is unchanged.
quarterly_data.counterparty_role: academic collaborator expected to conduct initial clinical testing of EVX-05
